concept.contract: The way named by the region formal is an undivided highway carrying travel in both senses at the observation, as the map represents it: no median or dividing section lies on that way, and two of the travel regions lying on it - a lane or a roadway, the regions a vehicle proceeds in - carry designated directions that are opposed, the cosine of the angle between the two direction vectors, read in the world frame, being below the negative of the opposition tolerance, a ratio between minus one and one. The two travel regions need not be of one kind and need not be lanes: a way a map cuts along its centre into two roadways carrying opposed designated directions, with no lane distinguished on it, carries travel in both senses as much as a way mapped as two opposed lanes, and a kind that refines a lane or a roadway - a reserved lane, a turn lane, a one-way roadway - is one of those kinds. A shoulder is not read as a sense of travel, being the part of the highway beside the roadway not intended for vehicular traffic, and neither is a bicycle lane or path, which is reserved for bicycles. The definition the contract reads states that vehicles are allowed to proceed in opposite directions on such a way, and that permission is read through the directions the map designates for the way's travel regions, which is the observable evidence of it. The definition it reads is "an undivided highway upon which vehicles are allowed to proceed in opposite directions". The concept states a configuration of one way at one observation and nothing about any road user. Not a stand-in for: the presence of a centre line marking, since an unmarked way whose travel regions carry opposed designated directions is two-directional and a marked line on its own says nothing of the directions; the width of the way or the number of its lanes; a road user's own direction of travel, which the concept does not read; or a way divided by a median or a dividing section, which carries travel in both senses and which the concept excludes, that exclusion being the one the definition's word undivided requires.

params.name: direction_opposition_cosine
params.meaning: the cosine of the largest angle off exactly opposed at which two designated directions still count as opposed; the tolerance within which the observed directions of two travel regions are read as the two senses of one way

elements.justification: `st.median_or_divider` is the 'physical barrier or dividing section between roadways; opening attribute where a crossover exists', which is exactly what makes a highway divided in the definition's sense, and `st.on_way` is 'the public way a structure region lies on - a lane, roadway, shoulder, crosswalk, stop line, median or any other part of it', so 'undivided' is read as no region of that kind lying on the way named by the formal, written as a universal quantifier over the regions of kind median_or_divider. `st.on_way` is 'not a stand-in for nearness to a way', so a barrier beside another way is not read as dividing this one; and a region whose kind the source cannot tell leaves the quantifier unknown rather than true by absence.

elements.span: two of the travel regions lying on it - a lane or a roadway, the regions a vehicle proceeds in - carry designated directions that are opposed
elements.justification: `st.lane_direction` is the 'direction of travel designated for a structure a vehicle travels in - a lane, reserved lane, turn lane, bicycle lane or path, or a roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder', read normalised as the atom's contract prescribes, so two designated directions whose cosine is below the negative of the tolerance are the two opposite senses the definition names. The travel regions a vehicle proceeds in are of two kinds the vocabulary carries apart: `st.lane`, 'a longitudinal strip of roadway for one line of vehicles', and `st.roadway`, 'the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic, excluding shoulder; separate roadways of a divided highway are separate'. A region quantifier ranges over one kind and the kinds that refine it, and `st.lane` is not declared to refine `st.roadway`, so no single quantifier covers both: the pair of opposed regions is written as a disjunction of the three nestings - lane with lane, roadway with roadway, lane with roadway - which is why both atoms are read and why a way mapped as two opposed roadways with no lane on it is not dropped. The kinds that refine either (`st.reserved_lane`, `st.turn_lane`, `st.centre_turn_lane`, `st.one_way_roadway`) come with their parent's quantifier and are read through it. `st.on_way` ties every such region to the way named by the formal, so the directions compared are of that way and not of a crossing one. The two excluded kinds are excluded by their own contracts: `st.shoulder` is 'the part of the highway beside the roadway not intended for vehicular traffic' and `st.bicycle_lane_or_path` is a 'lane or separate path reserved for bicycles', so neither is a sense in which vehicles proceed on the way. `st.lane_direction` is respected: a direction is local to its carrier and a place no carrier covers has none, so a way whose travel regions carry no designated direction leaves the concept unknown rather than false, and a centre turn lane, which the atom says carries none, contributes nothing decided either way.

residues.why: which classes of road user the permission extends to is not read: the concept reads the directions the map designates for the way's lanes and roadways, not the classes admitted to them, so a way whose designated directions are opposed counts whatever classes may use it

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: An urban street an HD map cuts along its centre: two roadway regions lie on the way, one with a designated direction due east and the other with a direction almost exactly opposed to it, no lane is distinguished on the way at all, and no median or dividing section region lies on it anywhere along its length. A map that labels each half a one-way roadway changes nothing, that kind refining roadway.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: A divided arterial: two lanes lying on the way carry opposed designated directions, but a median region lies on that way between the two carriageways, so the way is not undivided.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The way carries two roadway regions and, on them, two lanes, and no median region lies on it, but the source designates no direction of travel for any of those regions, so whether travel on the way runs in both senses cannot be decided.
